answer: Nobody is taken on trust here; the proof is the book. Glazier pane record with glaziers attestation is the proof the town accepts: eight-year record, 6,000 panes glazed, lead accounts, yearly review. Slip in a borrowed walnut and the entry is struck through, the cheat pays the price of the goods twice over and the wharf is seized by the wardens, while the ferrous is kept by the clerk and read aloud at Michaelmas.
